svg.aria-label: Pluto: a language model built from scratch in plain PyTorch. Pipeline: raw text, clean and dedupe, byte-level BPE tokenizer, token shards, GPT, training loop with exact resume. Milestone 1: about 6M parameters trained on 197M tokens in 18 minutes on a free T4, validation loss 1.738. Milestone 2: first voice model, 18.8% WER. Roadmap to Mini-Live, a real-time speech and text model.
